pairs.subject: prompt-safety
pairs.evidence: scripts/ci/lane-canary.mjs:2 Every script in this context is a deterministic Node gate over files on disk (lane artifacts, flake register, target/ size, Rust source spellings) and none of them builds a prompt or reads model output: case-insensitive searches of scripts/ci for prompt, llm, untrusted, injection, anthropic and 'claude -p' returned no hits, so there is no untrusted-span-to-model boundary for this subject to govern.

techniques.evidence: scripts/ci/lane-canary.mjs:2 This canary checks that the CI lane judge is alive by planting a breach of a declared bound. No prompt boundary is crossed and no model run emits a marker.
scripts/ci/mcp-gate-parity.mjs:2 A static check that tool names are spelled the same way in Rust source. It judges no agent session, credential or egress.
scripts/ci/mcp-gate-parity.mjs:17 The parity checked is between three sites in one Rust file. It is not a prompt-safety rule implemented twice across a language boundary.
